# netbox_circuit (Data Source)

Retrieves a single circuit from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_circuit" "example" {
  id          = 1
  provider_id = 1
}

output "circuit_id" {
  value = data.netbox_circuit.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cid` (String) The cid of the circuit.
- `commit_rate` (Number) The commit rate of the circuit.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the circuit.
- `install_date` (String) The install date of the circuit.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the circuit.
- `provider_account_id` (Number) The ID of the provider account associated with the circuit.
- `provider_id` (Number) The ID of the provider associated with the circuit.
- `status` (String) The status of the circuit.
- `tenant_id` (Number) The ID of the tenant associated with the circuit.
- `termination_a_id` (Number) The ID of the termination a associated with the circuit.
- `termination_date` (String) The termination date of the circuit.
- `termination_z_id` (Number) The ID of the termination z associated with the circuit.
- `type_id` (Number) The ID of the type associated with the circuit.

### Read-Only

- `assignments` (List of Number) The IDs of the assignments of the circuit.
- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the circuit.
- `created` (String) When the circuit was created.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the circuit, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the circuit.
- `distance` (Number) The distance of the circuit.
- `distance_unit` (String) The distance unit of the circuit.
- `last_updated` (String) When the circuit was last changed.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
